items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: We'd be taking things off the records, like Red Nichols.

ctx.x: then. Because I... We just...a couple of other little cats I knew, we were playing around, you know. We'd be taking things off the records, like Red Nichols. Because I wasn't exposed to Louis Armstrong then, you know. Or Bix. It was Rex then, and Red Nichols, you know.

Well, actually, what got me started was the trumpet player that was in my brother's band, a ...(?)... named Archie Johnson. He was a killer, man, you know. Then Rex came and stayed at our house, and he showed me a couple of breaks. Man, he was really my idol. I mean, like I couldn't... I didn't dig it because I didn't get fat like he was, you know, so I could look like him. I started to do everything he did, you know. When he came in with Fletcher, he got me and took me, and he set behind me and he's showing what…
